req.title: Reflect query parameters on GET
req.statement: The system shall include client-supplied query parameters under the 'args' key of the GET /get response body.
expected_outcomes: response args field mirrors query string

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /get must reflect client-supplied query parameters under the 'args' key. I designed tests covering: (1) a positive EP case with a single k=v pair asserting exact key and value; (2) a positive EP case with multiple parameters; (3) a negative/NEG case with no query parameters asserting args is an empty dict; (4) a BVA boundary case with a single-character key and empty-string value; (5) a DT case with special characters in values; (6) a NEG case verifying wrong HTTP method returns 405. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant, operator, and key-name mutations.

tests.name: test_get_single_query_param_reflected_in_args
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-002: args key mirrors query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_single_query_param_reflected_in_args():
    r = client.get('/get?foo=bar')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert 'args' in body
    assert body['args'] == {'foo': 'bar'}
    assert len(body['args']) == 1

test_get_single_query_param_reflected_in_args()

client = app.test_client()

def test_get_special_characters_in_query_value_reflected_exactly():
    r = client.get('/get?msg=hello+world&code=a%3Db')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert 'args' in body
    assert body['args']['msg'] == 'hello world'
    assert body['args']['code'] == 'a=b'

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
semiflatten returns list when key appears more than once
expected: args['k'] is a list ['v1', 'v2'] (multi-value key boundary)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-002: boundary — duplicate query key triggers semiflatten list path; both values must appear
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_duplicate_key_query_param_reflected_as_list():
    r = client.get('/get?k=v1&k=v2')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert 'args' in body
    assert 'k' in body['args']
    val = body['args']['k']
    assert isinstance(val, list)
    assert val == ['v1', 'v2']
    assert len(val) == 2
